prompt: Use case: illustration-story. One landscape 1536x1024 hand-inked investigative comic panel. Input image is STYLE / ordinary institutional material reference only. Close on a modest desktop monitor in the same gray fluorescent office, screen nearly flat to camera and occupying upper 70% of image. Show two simple reconstructed interface areas side by side. Left heading exactly HISTORY; beneath it four widely spaced plain neutral rectangular bars representing Artifactory request history, no text or glyphs in bars. Right heading exactly NOTES; beneath it four plain file-note rectangles, without words, code or fake prose. A single thin muted moss-green #74864F edge on each note rectangle marks only these communication objects. No green elsewhere. Monitor hardware matte and ordinary, no brand, no buttons with text. No humans necessary. Dirty off-white, charcoal #101214, desaturated steel #5E737B, dry brush, heavy nib shadows, restrained halftone. Bottom 25% near-black and empty for later caption. No causal arrow to anything external, no later incident consequence, no payloads, paths, URLs, timestamps, invented glyphs, logos, neon, glow, claret or amber. No speech balloons, captions, outer panel border or multiple panels. Readable distinction of history and notes is primary; interface bodies deliberately abstract, not source quotation.
controls: Model revision, seed, sampler, strength and billing unavailable.
